name: Photomath
summary: Maths app that scans problems with the camera and explains step-by-step solutions.
description: Photomath scans handwritten or printed maths problems, including word problems, and shows step-by-step solutions and explanations; problems can also be typed in a smart calculator. The Basic plan is free. Plus costs $9.99 per month or $69.99 per year and adds extra explanations and visual aids, with a trial available. It is available as a mobile app. Problems that are hard to type can be scanned directly from paper.
